portfolio_boundary.primary_axis: behavior owner before benchmark workload, comparative baseline, timing row, cache row, raw sample packet, report root, artifact root, package staging, machine profile, generated report, public command wrapper, or retired-surface claim
portfolio_boundary.support_authority: benchmark workloads and comparative baselines are timing/provenance rows; canonical support is owned by behavior owner splits and cannot be inferred from workload names, benchmark classes, report roots, public commands, expected exit codes, or raw samples
portfolio_boundary.comparative_baseline_rule: Objective-C 2, Swift, and C++ reference baselines are comparison provenance only and cannot create Objective-C 3 behavior support
portfolio_boundary.retired_surface_rule: compatibility, fallback, wrapper-only, unsupported, old-mode, shim, generated-only, report-only, migration-only, cache-only, timing-only, local-only, hand-normalized, screenshot-derived, foreign-baseline, and cross-machine universal claims map to canonical_rejection or performance_provenance
portfolio_boundary.evidence_boundary_rule: parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, e2e, comparative baseline, benchmark timing, report publication, public command routing, raw sample, cache row, machine profile, and generated telemetry evidence are separately routed

behavior_phase_split_indexes.boundary: source-form provenance for Objective-C 3 showcase workloads
story capability provenance for categories, reflection, status bridging, actors, derives, macros, property behaviors, and interop
compile-latency and emitted-code workload shape before runtime or e2e measurement
artifact roots, package staging, telemetry schema, compile output, and generated report provenance
runtime-wall-clock workload rows and expected exit-code provenance after runtime behavior ownership
benchmark workflow shape, same-machine comparison rows, public commands, raw samples, report publication, and comparative baseline publication

compatibility, fallback, shim, old-mode, unsupported, wrapper-only, local-only, report-only, generated-only, migration-only, cache-only, timing-only, cross-machine, screenshot-derived, hand-normalized, and foreign-baseline rows

benchmark portfolio rows, measurement policy rows, benchmark parameter rows, comparative baseline rows, public command wrappers, report roots, artifact roots, raw samples, machine profiles, tool versions, normalized values, generated reports, cache rows, timing rows, and owner split routing metadata

objc3_workloads.support_boundary: showcase workload timing only; categories, reflection, and synthesized behavior support must be cited through canonical phase owners
showcase workload timing only; status bridging, actor, and runtime messaging support must be cited through canonical phase owners
showcase workload timing only; derives, macros, property behaviors, and interop are support only through behavior owners, while compatibility-like interop claims route to canonical rejection

comparative_baselines.support_boundary: Objective-C 2 reference baseline is comparative provenance only and cannot define Objective-C 3 old-mode or compatibility support
Swift reference baseline is comparative provenance only and cannot define Objective-C 3 behavior support or interop compatibility
C++ reference baseline is comparative provenance only and cannot define Objective-C 3 behavior support or compatibility support

explicit_non_goals: no hidden baseline sources outside checked-in fixtures
